Project 01 ⭐ Featured
SCARA Robot Redesign
Led a 7-member team to redesign a 4-axis SCARA (Selective Compliance Assembly Robot Arm) achieving ~90% pick-and-place accuracy. Full mechanical redesign in SolidWorks including gear transmission, stepper motor integration, and custom gripper end-effector. Validated with real prototype build and motion testing.
